invariants.rationale: The method always returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object and not null based on the use of 'new ...().execute()'.
The 'records' parameter is always passed into the method and used in the execution flow.
The 'instantTime' parameter is propagated through to execution and is not expected to be null.
The 'context' parameter is required for method execution and is cast to HoodieJavaEngineContext, so it must not be null.
The result is explicitly of type HoodieWriteMetadata.
